svg.text: Dashes flow along the gene's links. Motion only; nothing else changes.
Same language as link hover: the gene, its partners and its links stay; the rest fades; a label counts its links.
As B, but links it regulates are near-black and links regulating it are ochre, so in/out reads at a glance.
Nothing fades: the gene grows 15 % with a soft shadow and its links darken. Quietest option.
